properties.name: ROOT CAUSE (walked, measured): CI's full job died of 'No space left on device' on #652 after its workspace tests PASSED, the second time after #593. The term that grew is RocksDB's debug info carried by every test executable: librocksdb.a went 0.89 to 1.04 GB at 11.8.1, 54% of it DWARF. The class is that the job's disk use is never measured, so it fails only when exceeded
properties.source: GitHub Actions job 110975563298 (#652) and its annotation; job log of #651's passing run 37020929764; local librocksdb.a measured with `size -A`; the comment on ci.yml's Free disk space step
properties.statement:
RUN AS THE SKILL (root-cause, fetched fresh), 2026-10-02, dev_reflow2 hub session, on #652 (rocksdb 0.24 → 0.25).

① OBSERVED: the job "workspace + real-binary instruments" ended `failure` with one annotation, "Unhandled exception. System.IO.IOException: No space left on device : '/home/runner/actions-runner/cached/2.337.0/_diag/Worker_....log'". Step 6, "Workspace tests (both crates)", is `success`; steps 7 on never ran; the job log was never stored (BlobNotFound). Expected: the job passes, as on #651 the same afternoon. NOT affected: the three other jobs, including the build at the 1.98 floor.

② PRECEDENT: ci.yml's comment on "Free disk space (room for a second RocksDB build)" records the same symptom on #593, 2026-09-26 ("Clippy's step failed on 'No space left on device' with every test green"). It was read then as TWO RocksDB builds, the cache's and a rebuild, and contained by deleting preinstalled toolchains, with the warning "any dependency that moves a shared build crate does this again".

③ CANDIDATES:
(1) Two RocksDB builds, as the precedent read it.
(2) A bigger RocksDB, multiplied by every test executable that links it.
(3) Less disk on the runner today.
(4) The observation is wrong.

④⑤ MEASURED:
- #651's passing run had 105 GB free after the cleanup step (146 GB disk).
- Its restored cache is 2.59 GB compressed, so the cached build beside a rebuild is too small to fill 105 GB. (1) is real but not the term that matters.
- librocksdb.a is 0.89 GB at 10.4.2 and 1.04 GB at 11.8.1 (+17%). The debug sections are 0.49 and 0.56 GB (55%, 54%); the machine code is 19 and 24 MB.
- The workspace has 331 test files, each its own executable, and those that touch the store link RocksDB statically.
- So (2) is the term that grew.
- (3) is unlikely: same day, same image, 105 GB free.
- (4) is ruled out by the runner's own annotation.

⑥ CLASS: the full job's disk use is never measured. It ran at the edge and failed only when exceeded, with tests green, twice. #593's containment made room and left the size invisible.

⑦⑧ FIX in #652 (ci.yml, full job):
- CFLAGS/CXXFLAGS=-g0, which drops C and C++ dependencies' debug info, the dominant term. Rust's own debug info is unchanged.
- A step after the tests that prints free disk, the target size and librocksdb.a's size on every run, and warns under 20 GB free.
It would also have prevented #593, whose growth was the same term.

⑨ NOT ESTABLISHED:
- this job's peak use on main, which was never printed (the new step prints it from now on);
- whether cc appends CFLAGS after its own -g (the new step's librocksdb.a size shows whether -g0 took effect);
- that #652 now passes, which the rerun shows.
